daily.title: Shared grocery list for flatmates
daily.pitch: One live list for the whole flat, with who-bought-what and a quick split at month end.
daily.problem: Flatmates buy duplicates, forget essentials and argue about who paid.
daily.whoPays: Flatmates on a freemium plan; co-living operators for a branded version.
daily.pricing: Free for one flat; $2 per month for receipts and the monthly split.
mvp: Tick items off and add prices
daily.firstUsers: Use it in your own flat and two friends' flats, then post in hostel groups.
daily.stack: Expo (React Native) with Supabase for auth and real-time sync

daily.title: Study room finder for campus
daily.pitch: See which classrooms and library rooms are free right now and book a slot for your group.
daily.problem: Students wander the campus looking for an empty room to study in together.
daily.whoPays: Colleges, as a campus license; free for students.
mvp: Import the timetable to know which rooms are free
Live list or map of free rooms
daily.firstUsers: Build it for your own college from its public timetable and share it in batch groups.
daily.stack: Next.js with Supabase (Postgres), installable as a PWA

daily.title: Pet care log shared by the family
daily.pitch: Everyone in the house logs walks, meals and medicine, so the pet is never double-fed or forgotten.
daily.problem: Families text each other 'did anyone feed the dog?' every single day.
daily.whoPays: Pet-owning families; pet sitters on a pro plan.
daily.pricing: Free for one pet; $3 per month for more pets and vet records.
mvp: One-tap logs for walks, meals and meds
daily.firstUsers: Put QR posters up in two vet clinics and a pet store near you.

daily.title: Booking page for home tutors
daily.pitch: Tutors share one link where parents book slots, pay and get reminders.
daily.problem: Home tutors manage bookings over calls and chase payments at the end of every month.
daily.firstUsers: Set it up for five tutors you know and ask each to pass it to one colleague.
daily.stack: Next.js with Postgres and Stripe or Razorpay

daily.title: Run club app with weekly routes
daily.pitch: Organizers post the weekly route and meetup point; members RSVP and see who's coming.
daily.problem: Run clubs coordinate in huge WhatsApp groups where the route gets buried.
daily.whoPays: Run club organizers; clubs pay for branding and member management.
daily.pricing: Free for 20 members; $9 per month per club.
mvp: Post a route on a map
daily.firstUsers: Join a weekend run club and offer to run their next three meetups on it.

daily.title: Receipt scanner for freelancers' taxes
daily.pitch: Snap receipts, auto-fill amount and category, and export a tidy report at tax time.
daily.problem: Freelancers lose receipts and spend a stressful week rebuilding their expenses.
daily.pricing: Free for 20 receipts a month; $5 per month unlimited.
daily.firstUsers: Offer a free year to freelancers in two online communities before tax season.
daily.stack: Flutter or Expo with an OCR API and Postgres

daily.title: Walk-in queue for salons and small clinics
daily.pitch: Customers scan a QR code to join the queue and get a message when it's their turn.
daily.problem: Customers wait in crowded rooms with no idea how long it will take.
daily.whoPays: Salons, small clinics and repair shops.
mvp: QR code to join the queue
SMS or WhatsApp when it's your turn
Staff view to call the next person
daily.firstUsers: Set it up for free at a salon near campus and count how many walk-outs it saves.
daily.stack: SvelteKit or Next.js with Postgres and an SMS API

daily.title: Wedding photo drop for guests
daily.pitch: Guests scan a QR code at the venue and add their photos to one shared album, no app needed.
daily.problem: The best candid photos stay stuck on guests' phones after the wedding.
daily.whoPays: Couples, per wedding; photographers resell it as an add-on.
mvp: Upload from the browser with no sign-up
Live slideshow for the venue screen
daily.firstUsers: Offer it free at a friend's wedding and hand out cards to other guests.
daily.stack: Next.js with S3-compatible storage such as Cloudflare R2

daily.title: Habit tracker for two
daily.pitch: Pair up with one friend on one habit and see each other's daily check-ins.
daily.problem: Solo habit apps get abandoned; accountability with one friend works far better.
daily.pricing: Free for one pair; $2 per month for more habits and stats.
daily.firstUsers: Launch it with a 30-day challenge in your college's gym or coding club.
daily.stack: Expo with Supabase and push notifications

daily.title: Order-ahead app for college canteens
daily.pitch: Students order from the canteen on their phone and pick up when it's ready.
daily.problem: Canteen queues eat half the lunch break.
daily.whoPays: Canteen operators; colleges for a campus license.
mvp: Kitchen screen with the order queue
daily.firstUsers: Pilot it with one canteen for a week and measure the queue time before and after.
daily.stack: Next.js PWA with Postgres and a payment gateway

daily.title: Neighborhood tool library
daily.pitch: Neighbors list tools they rarely use and lend them with a simple request-and-return flow.
daily.problem: Everyone owns a drill they use twice a year, and the neighbor buys another one.
daily.firstUsers: Start in your own building's group chat with ten items from friends.
daily.stack: Django or Rails with Postgres, as a mobile-friendly web app

daily.title: Practice log for music students
daily.pitch: Students log practice with a timer and short recordings; teachers see progress before each lesson.
daily.problem: Music teachers can't tell whether students practiced, and students lose motivation.
daily.whoPays: Music teachers and small music schools.
daily.firstUsers: Offer it to three music teachers and their students for a free term.
daily.stack: Expo with Supabase storage for recordings
